description: Live HCORTEX 1.0 preview, real-time CORTEX validation, C14N canonical hash and safe bidirectional editing — powered by the codec-cortex toolchain.
cmd.openPreviewToSide: Open HCORTEX Preview to the Side
cfg.toolchainPath: Explicit codec-cortex toolchain command (e.g. /path/to/cortex). Empty = automatic priority chain.
cfg.debounceMs: Debounce in ms to refresh preview and diagnostics after each edit.
cfg.formatOnSave: Format to canonical form (canonicalize) when saving the document.
cfg.inlineDiagnostics: Show diagnostics inline at end of line (Error Lens style). Messages come from cortex-ls.
